name: Brood-based Vector Quantization
definition: Compresses inter-level data residuals by grouping them into 'broods' (blocks of 2^d children) and replacing each block with a codebook index.
summary: Brood-based Vector Quantization is a lossy compression technique for adaptive trees that groups spatial residuals into broods and replaces them with codebook indices, reducing error by correcting coarse-level mistakes in finer levels.
